description: Instantiate an analog video-synthesizer pattern (lissajous oscillator curve, moving interference fringes, or CRT scanline modulation) into a GLSL TOP with live Speed / FreqX / FreqY / Scale / Color controls, output as a Null TOP inside a new 'video_synth_<mode>' container under parent_path. An oscillator/interference generator for VJ work — distinct from create_shader_lib's tunnel/raymarch/fractal/metaball looks. Use create_video_player instead when you want to play a real movie file rather than generate a pattern. Returns the chosen mode, its parameters, and a preview of the output TOP.

color.description: Base color as hex (e.g. '#33ccff'); parsed to 0..1 RGB and exposed as 'Color'.

expose_controls.description: Expose live Speed / FreqX / FreqY / Scale / Color controls on the system container.

freq_x.description: X-axis oscillator frequency (uFreqX). Exposed as a live 'FreqX' control.

freq_y.description: Y-axis oscillator frequency (uFreqY). Exposed as a live 'FreqY' control.

mode.description: Oscillator look: 'lissajous' (two-oscillator X/Y curve), 'interference' (moving sine fringes), or 'scanlines' (analog CRT scanline modulation).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained 'video_synth_<mode>' container is created inside.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] of the GLSL TOP.

scale.description: Pattern scale/zoom multiplier (uScale). Exposed as a live 'Scale' control.

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier (drives uTime). Exposed as a live 'Speed' control.

name: create_video_synth
title: Create video synth
